question: What worldly and otherworldly rewards result from this ritual practice?
premises: The practitioner obtains lineage and prosperity here.
The practitioner obtains Vaikuṇṭha after death.
These are stated as results of the practice.
inference: The practice yields lineage and prosperity in this life and Vaikuṇṭha after death.
plain_english: Here one obtains lineage and prosperity, and when dead one attains Vaikuṇṭha.
